verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for a live llms.txt at https://docs.github.com/llms.txt. It opens with a '# GitHub Docs' header and a product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. The evidence confirms the file exists but says little about how deep or well-structured it is. missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt coverage/structure (e.g., linked per-page markdown or an llms-full variant), first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs, independent corroboration of agent usability.
